description: This file contains functions and types related to group gating logic in a WhatsApp auto-reply system, including handling group policies, mentions, and message history.

methods.name: isOwnerSender
methods.description: Checks if the message sender is an owner based on the mention configuration.

methods.name: recordPendingGroupHistoryEntry
methods.description: Records a pending group message history entry with sender info and message details.

methods.name: skipGroupMessageAndStoreHistory
methods.description: Logs and stores a group message without processing further.

methods.name: applyGroupGating
methods.description: Main function to determine if a group message should be processed based on policies, mentions, and history.
